purpose: Build/link one private constant-k Darcy component with the newly rebuilt authoritative GPU objects. The driver never invokes the resulting program, help command, solver, worker, notification or Git.

prerequisites.stage_binding: Require its passed bounded k0 actual/smoke result and bind the aggregate file hash. Do not recursively traverse historical publication/status records: the old mutable validation status is not an immutable current-source predicate.
prerequisites.current_source: Require the successful owned /t:Rebuild call, all 265 current frozen project-source files, five_targets, immutable baseline's other 260 files, 110 unique authoritative objects excluding main, tools/runtime/canonical-program identities. A later selective checkpoint is allowed only while these exact current source/build bindings remain unchanged.
prerequisites.historical_identity: Verify old helper/compile/link receipts, authors, input receipt files, tools and libraries by hash. Read oldh.source_build.no_space_IntDir and its recorded object inventory to identify the OLD link prefix; do not compare that historical source inventory's five edited paths against current files.

transitive_includes: The component renames and includes the retained Time main, preserving one AppInfo definition. The retained Time CPP is explicitly hash-locked to e886b659688ea369a3a30b8384ffa4c8f6ede4efd1342a288aebf24cdc712f95; its project-header closure is covered by the complete current 265-file source freeze. Toolchain/CUDA/system headers follow the unchanged authoritative toolchain recipe, not a new independent external-header audit.

exact_remaps.compiler: Exactly one old Time CPP source argument becomes the new component CPP, plus exactly /Fo helper.obj and /Fd compile.pdb; every other compile argument is unchanged.
exact_remaps.linker: Exactly /OUT, one helper.obj and Debug-only /PDB change. Exactly 110 object arguments identified under OLD h.source_build.no_space_IntDir map by unique exact basename to NEW g.no_space_IntDir objects. Reject duplicate, missing or foreign objects. Verify the entire final object-argument set is precisely one helper.obj plus all 110 current source-build objects.
exact_remaps.expected_receipt: GPU_object_substitutions=110, GPU_object_directory_changed=true, link_object_count=111, exact_link_closure_verified=true. This is argument/object identity, not solver or physical validation.

new_outputs.compile_and_link: Separate owned *_compile.call.json/*_link.call.json and logs; nonzero exit preserves evidence and stops before success receipt.
new_outputs.runtime: Copy only the exact runtime support files from the newly isolated Darcy GPU build, including Chrono DLLs/configuration; hash each copy against its new-build source. Do not overwrite canonical executables/server packages or retained outputs.

scope: BuildComponent only; no automatic Run and no helper execution
Root must finish reading and freeze the final component CPP/note before authorized build
No production source or equation change and no new public GPU option
No numeric thresholds are changed or interpreted by this compile/link wrapper
Component memcheck/Debug/Release/native regressions/actual integration and physical acceptance remain later separate gates
No source/executable backup copies and no recursive old mutable-status hash verification
